project_info.name: Spend Better Free Time (Passa meglio il tempo libero)
project_info.stack: React (JS), Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons, Leaflet Maps, FastAPI Backend

visual_identity.theme_archetype: Pastel & Soft with Vibrant Accent (Archetype 3 - Mobile-first Organic & Playful)

layout_and_navigation.pwa_features: Standalone display mode, Manifest JSON, Service Worker for offline fallback, Add to Home Screen prompt banner
layout_and_navigation.header: Sticky Glassmorphic Header with Logo, Language Selector dropdown, Location Status badge, PWA Install button, Profile avatar link
layout_and_navigation.bottom_navigation: Mobile Floating Bottom Navigation Bar with active state pink highlight and indicators for Home, Map, Groups/Chat, AI Assistant, History/Favorites, Profile
layout_and_navigation.responsive_breakpoints: Mobile-first layout (< 640px bottom nav active, >= 768px expanded sidebar + top nav)

key_features_and_components.authentication: Email/Password login, Google Emergent OAuth, Password Reset modal/flow with email notification simulation

onboarding_flow.step_1: Personal details (Name, Age, Resident City, Gender)
onboarding_flow.step_2: 10-15 Hobbies selection with drag & drop reordering or step re-prioritization controls
onboarding_flow.step_3: Facebook / Instagram groups interest tags & custom group links
onboarding_flow.step_4: Optional geolocation permission consent with privacy note

home_feed.header_controls: Date and Time range selector + Current Weather card with temperature & icons
home_feed.ai_suggestions: AI Generated Activity Cards featuring category badge, estimated duration, weather suitability tag, distance/city, match score %, 'Add to Favorites' heart toggle, 'Mark Done' thumb button

key_features_and_components.map_view: Interactive Leaflet Map with custom pink markers for activity suggestions, category filter pills, and popup cards
key_features_and_components.group_chat: Group proposal chat room with activity voting polls, proposed time slots, and message threads
key_features_and_components.ai_assistant_chat: Dedicated interactive AI leisure concierge for custom queries ('What can I do today at 4pm with 2 friends in Milan?')
key_features_and_components.history_and_feedback: Completed activities list with thumbs up / thumbs down rating system affecting future AI rankings
key_features_and_components.donations_section: PayPal button integration + Direct IBAN copy-to-clipboard widget with quick copy toast
key_features_and_components.privacy_policy: Dedicated page at /api/privacy rendering compliant GDPR privacy guidelines

image_urls.description: Group of friends having fun outdoors
Group sitting at the beach sunset

testing_requirements.rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST have data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the mobile responsive web application and PWA with manifest.json and service-worker.js.
Implement internationalization for 8 languages (it, en, fr, es, de, zh, ar, pt) with RTL support when 'ar' is selected.
Utilize vibrant pink accents (#E83D84) with soft rose tones and clean white/dark contrast surfaces.
Rely on existing FastAPI backend endpoints for auth, hobbies, suggestions, weather, and AI assistant.
Ensure every form control, button, card, and interactive element has explicit data-testid attributes.
